PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-024.text: Trie root computation via any code path (constructor, deserializer, copy) must yield identical root for identical data.
PROP-9ffb0e64-inv-024.assertion: forall construction_path p1, p2: data(p1) == data(p2) => root(trie(p1)) == root(trie(p2))

locations.note: Root hash computation is deterministic regardless of construction path
